+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Describe native n/v/F residual changes for registered CT input controls.
+
+No simulations, normalization, phase fitting or model selection. --refresh-native
+only runs the existing read-only native analyzer on completed registered cases.
+All scores retain individual instruments/quantities; no composite winner exists.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from astropy.time import Time
+
+from analyze_native_model import FIELDS, MONITORS, metric
+from case_selection import case_provenance, completed
+from compare_ct_native import timing, utc
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/"scripts"))
+import build_ct_report as builder
+
+
+def relative(path):
+    return str(path.resolve().relative_to(ROOT))
+
+
+def readjson(path):
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+
+def registered_pairs(plan, audit):
+    nominal = plan["temporal_control"]["baseline"]
+    pairs = [[item["left"], item["right"]] for item in audit.get("physics", {}).get("comparisons", []) if item.get("right") == nominal]
+    overrides = plan.get("physical_controls", {}).get("comparison_overrides", {}).values()
+    pairs += [item["comparison_pair"] for item in overrides if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("comparison_pair"), list) and len(item["comparison_pair"]) == 2]
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(tuple(pair) for pair in pairs))
+
+
+def source_pins(cases):
+    paths = [ROOT/"observations"/name for name in ("analyze_native_model.py", "case_selection.py", "plasma_wind.tsv", "plasma_stereo_a.tsv", "plasma_solar_orbiter.tsv")]
+    paths += [ROOT/"inputs/metadata.json", ROOT/"external_model/ccmc_profiles.npz"]
+    paths += [ROOT/"results"/name/file for name in cases for file in ("probe.csv", "run.cfg", "statistics.json", "metadata.json", "candidate_status.json")]
+    return {relative(path): builder.sha(path) for path in paths}
+
+
+def refresh_native(cases, directory):
+    before = source_pins(cases)
+    command = [sys.executable, str(ROOT/"observations/analyze_native_model.py"), "--cases", *cases, "--output-dir", str(directory), "--no-plot"]
+    subprocess.run(command, check=True, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
+    if before != source_pins(cases):
+        raise ValueError("Native analyzer source/data/case files changed during scoring; refresh after inputs stabilize")
+    receipt = dict(created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), command=command, no_model_runs=True, source_inputs_sha256=before,
+                   output_sha256={file: builder.sha(directory/file) for file in ("inhouse_native.json", "inhouse_native.tsv")})
+    (directory/"native_generation_receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+"\n")
+
+
+def load_native(directory, cases):
+    receipt = readjson(directory/"native_generation_receipt.json")
+    if receipt.get("source_inputs_sha256") != source_pins(cases):
+        raise ValueError("Native generation receipt does not cover the exact current completed case set/sources; use --refresh-native")
+    for file in ("inhouse_native.json", "inhouse_native.tsv"):
+        if receipt.get("output_sha256", {}).get(file) != builder.sha(directory/file):
+            raise ValueError("Stale native output: "+file)
+    report = readjson(directory/"inhouse_native.json")
+    if set(report.get("cases", {})) != set(cases):
+        raise ValueError("Native validation case set differs from current completed registered case set")
+    for case in cases:
+        for file in ("probe.csv", "run.cfg", "statistics.json", "metadata.json"):
+            if report.get("case_provenance", {}).get(case, {}).get("files", {}).get(file, {}).get("sha256") != builder.sha(ROOT/"results"/case/file):
+                raise ValueError("Stale native model case: "+case+"/"+file)
+    with (directory/"inhouse_native.tsv").open() as stream:
+        table = list(csv.DictReader(stream, delimiter="\t"))
+    return report, table
+
+
+def qualification(case, baseline, controls, audit, campaign):
+    check = next((item for item in controls["sections"]["physics"]["comparisons"] if (item["left"], item["right"]) == (case, baseline)), {})
+    raw = next((item for item in audit.get("physics", {}).get("comparisons", []) if (item["left"], item["right"]) == (case, baseline)), {})
+    record = campaign.get("cases", {}).get(case, {})
+    gates = record.get("formulation", {}).get("gates", {})
+    failed = {key: value for key, value in gates.items() if value.get("passed") is False}
+    completion = record.get("completion_evidence_sha256", {})
+    evidence_current = bool(completion) and all(Path(path).is_file() and builder.sha(Path(path)) == wanted for path, wanted in completion.items())
+    known_failure = evidence_current and bool(failed)
+    valid = check.get("valid") is True
+    label = "QUALIFIED physical sensitivity" if valid else "UNQUALIFIED: recorded formulation failure" if known_failure else "PENDING independent qualification/provenance refresh"
+    reasons = {name: audit.get("case_qualification", {}).get(name, {"passed": None, "reasons": ["No current independent case qualification"]}) for name in (case, baseline)}
+    return dict(label=label, qualified_for_sensitivity=valid, current_control_receipt=controls["receipt_valid"], case_qualification=reasons,
+                experiment_identity=raw.get("experiment_identity", {}), recorded_failed_formulation_gates=failed if evidence_current else {}, formulation_failure_evidence_current=evidence_current,
+                interpretation="Residuals below are descriptive diagnostics. An unqualified case is not a scientifically qualified physical control even if a particular residual improves; no composite model ranking or selection follows.")
+
+
+def compare_pair(case, baseline, table):
+    paired, output_rows = {}, []
+    for monitor in MONITORS:
+        keyed = {name: {float(row["mjd_utc"]): row for row in table if row["case"] == name and row["monitor"] == monitor} for name in (case, baseline)}
+        stamps = sorted(set(keyed[case]) & set(keyed[baseline]))
+        use = []
+        for stamp in stamps:
+            a, b = keyed[case][stamp], keyed[baseline][stamp]
+            good = True
+            for field in FIELDS:
+                obs, other = float(a["observed_"+field]), float(b["observed_"+field])
+                if obs != other and not (np.isnan(obs) and np.isnan(other)):
+                    raise ValueError("Native observed value changed across paired cases")
+                good &= all(np.isfinite(value) and value > 0 for value in (obs, float(a["inhouse_"+field]), float(b["inhouse_"+field])))
+            if good:
+                use.append(stamp)
+        if len(use) < 2:
+            raise ValueError("No common finite positive all-quantity native hours: "+monitor)
+        item = paired[monitor] = dict(common_finite_positive_all_quantity_hours=len(use), first_native_label_utc=utc(use[0]), last_native_label_utc=utc(use[-1]), excluded_invalid_common_hours=len(stamps)-len(use), quantities={})
+        for field in FIELDS:
+            observed = np.array([float(keyed[case][stamp]["observed_"+field]) for stamp in use])
+            predictions = {name: np.array([float(keyed[name][stamp]["inhouse_"+field]) for stamp in use]) for name in (case, baseline)}
+            scores = {name: metric(observed, values) for name, values in predictions.items()}
+            # Differences are signed, separate metrics, not an overall score.
+            changes = {"median_absolute_fractional_error_change": scores[case]["median_absolute_fractional_error"]-scores[baseline]["median_absolute_fractional_error"],
+                       "pearson_r_change": scores[case]["pearson_r"]-scores[baseline]["pearson_r"],
+                       "rms_log_ratio_change": scores[case]["rms_log_ratio"]-scores[baseline]["rms_log_ratio"],
+                       "median_model_over_observed_change": scores[case]["median_model_over_observed"]-scores[baseline]["median_model_over_observed"]}
+            item["quantities"][field] = dict(common_hour_metrics=scores, control_minus_matched_nominal=changes,
+                                             metric_direction="Lower MAFE/RMS log ratio, higher correlation, and a median model/observed ratio nearer one are different criteria; they can disagree.")
+            output_rows.append(dict(case=case, matched_nominal=baseline, monitor=monitor, quantity=field, common_hours=len(use),
+                                    control_median_model_over_observed=scores[case]["median_model_over_observed"], nominal_median_model_over_observed=scores[baseline]["median_model_over_observed"],
